tool_args.rationale: The concave pilot response supports the smooth siphon family, but s_grad spans only 0.018, so vmax and rho are nearly confounded. The cost-2 probe directly adds the missing gradient variation. Fit the resulting data over the full fallback parameter bounds rather than clipping rho to the warm-start range.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the smooth square-root siphon to the pilot
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot constrains the effective amplitude near s_grad = 1, but cannot reliably separate vmax from rho or verify predictions across a wider gradient range.
It costs more and targets temporal resolution rather than the missing sink-gradient variation.
